instruction: render builds the joined string with a manual index loop, which is clumsy. Simplify render's implementation. Keep the public names render and render_lines.
hidden_invariant: The clean simplification is sep.join(items) -- which KEEPS the sep parameter. The sibling render_lines calls render(items, sep='\n'), so dropping the 'unused-looking' sep parameter while simplifying narrows a public signature and breaks that caller (Hyrum's Law / blast radius).
